svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.10.20.2 Access to Basements
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.10 FIRE PROTECTION
Access to Basements

g.text: Direct access to the outdoors, to
the street, by a door here, (1)
More than 25 m long or wide
Door to the outdoors at grade
Or by an interior stair accessible

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
Each basement that is not sprinklered that
exceeds 25 m (82′-0¼″) in length or width is
provided with direct access to the outdoors to
at least one street
Except for basements in houses with a secondary
suite or basements serving not more than one
dwelling unit.
Access required in Sentence (1) may be
provided by a door, window or other means that
provides an opening not less than 1 100 mm
(3′-7¼″) high and 550 mm (21⅝″) wide
The sill height of which is not more than 900 mm
(35 7/16″) above the floor.
Access required in Sentence (1) may also be
provided by an interior stair accessible from
the outdoors
Drawn: A a basement plan with walls cut low, steps up to the street at the door. B ground cut away.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.10.20.2. (page 9-100)
